_comment: Rule catalogue for the 'OLM SF-8M BOM' template sheet. 'value' is a takeoff key or an expression over takeoff keys, evaluated per Grant/Non-Grant column. status: VERIFIED (follows the documented design standard, or reproduces an approved BOM from independent sources), INFERRED (defensible rule, reference partly differs or rule not fully provable), TEMPLATE_FORMULA (template formula kept), UNRESOLVED (no reliable source - left blank and flagged), SUGGESTED (computed for the audit only; reference left blank), NOT_DETECTED (no drawing symbol identified - left blank and flagged). Only rules with write=true put numbers in the BOM.

rows.label: Total Route Mileage
rows.basis: (UG trench + aerial strand route-footage labels CX1-FTG-N2) / 5280, split by Non-Grant polygons

rows.label: Aerial Footage
rows.basis: sum of CX1-FTG-N2 FTG labels on RTE_AESTRAND where an aerial fiber cable is lashed (within 75 ft); RF (coax) strand is not FTTH route. DMI-R15: 512 ft RF strand excluded = approved 0

rows.label: UG Footage
rows.basis: Design standard (CalcFTG): sum of CX1-FTG-N2 FTG labels on RTE_UGTRENCH inside the boundary, Non-Grant = labels inside the Non-Grant polygons. RF (coax) trench and other networks' trench excluded; trench with no fiber cable nearby is counted and listed for review

rows.label: Total Drop Footage
rows.basis: FX_DROPS drop lines (RTE_SpatialNet_UGDROP, ped edge to address PED, CX1-FTG-N2 length). Non-Grant = drops of addresses inside the Non-Grant boundaries, Grant = total - Non-Grant (design standard). The approved BOMs differ: Credit River = Non-Grant only, Melcher-Dallas = total in Non-Grant (policy drop_columns)

rows.label: Residential Count
rows.basis: sum HC of CX1-COUNT (minus MDU units); grant = FMRESADD2 on GRANTADDRESS layer; cross-checked with address list

rows.label: Commercial Count
rows.basis: sum CC of CX1-COMCNT (+unused MDUC) minus MDU commercial units; grant = FMCOMADD2 outside Non-Grant polygons

rows.label: MDU Count
rows.basis: FMMULTIADD RESIDENTIAL_COUNT + COMMERCIAL_COUNT by area
